reason: Adds a monotonic tracking generation and a single shared pending-start promise so concurrent starts reuse one watch. Stop invalidates pending intent immediately without awaiting the watch, while late subscriptions remove themselves and report start failure. Stale generation cleanup never touches newer handles. Failed remove() preserves the live handle and active flags for retry. Location callbacks and throttled timers are generation-guarded so late updates cannot mutate history. Background tracking only marks success when the active generation matches its own attempt. _resetState advances generation instead of resetting it to a reusable value, invalidating stale workers.
